{{Quote|You cursed me with this power, Karness Muur, so I'm using it to undo your plans! You can't take Vader if he's dead!|Celeste Morne|<ref name="DT12" />}}
The '''first duel on unidentified desert moon''' was a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]] fought in the year [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], between [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Covenant Shadow|Shadow]] [[Celeste Morne]] and the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], on a [[Unidentified desert moon|desolate moon]] orbiting a gas planet.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|It is my opinion that we have before us a stasis device of some kind, known as "Lord Dreypa's Oubliette", and that within is the Talisman of the Sith Lord Karness Muur &mdash; and a Jedi from forty centuries past.|[[Fane Peturri]]|<ref name="DT11" />}}
Determined to get rid of the infamous "[[Dreypa's Oubliette|Jebble Box]]," the crew of the ''[[Uhumele]]'' landed on a moon to sell it to [[Fane Peturri]], a well known scholar and historian. Unknown to the ''Uhumele's'' crew, Peturri was also an agent of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Vader, who learned of the ship's cargo from the [[Phindian/Legends|Phindian]] crewmember [[Janks]]. After having the crew cuffed to poles, Peturri began looking through a [[Marn Hierogryph's hologram|holographic message]] left by a [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Marn Hierogryph|crimelord]], detailing his memoirs, the [[Muur Talisman]], [[Jebble]] and [[rakghoul]]s, which was interrupted by his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] friend, [[Zayne Carrick]]. Peturri used the hologram to explain to Vader that he believed the Jebble Box contained the Muur Talisman, and also, a Jedi from forty centuries past.<ref name="DT11" />

Against Peturri's warnings about the [[Sith talisman/Legends|talisman]], Vader slashed the crate holding Dreypa's [[Oubliette (stasis casket)|Oubliette]] to open it, finding a young woman, [[Celeste Morne]], inside, with the Muur Talisman attached to her neck. In a panic, Peturri put on a helmet to avoid [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|infection]]. Celeste awoke, expecting to see Zayne Carrick, but still felt the spirit of [[Karness Muur]] alongside her. Muur cursed his enemy, [[Remulus Dreypa]], and his oubliette upon their release from the millennia imprisonment. Confused, Celeste asks Peturri about a [[Jedi Covenant|Covenant]], the rakghouls, the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], [[Mandalorian Wars|their conquest]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. Peturri informed her that the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Order 66/Legends|overthrew]] the Republic at which point she attacked Vader.<ref name="DT11" />

==The duel==
{{Quote|Let him kill you! Death will free you, Celeste!|Karness Muur|<ref name="DT12" />}}
Celeste faced off against Vader with her lightsaber and deflected blaster bolts from clone troopers. Despite the taunts of Vader, who sought a powerful apprentice he could use to overthrow [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], and of Muur, who sensed Vader could unleash the Muur Talisman's full power, Celeste reaffirmed her determination to keep it from him. Nonetheless, Vader overpowered Celeste in combat, but the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] hesitated to kill her and claim the talisman, realizing that to wield the talisman would merely be to trade slavery to Palpatine for slavery to Muur.<ref name="DT12" />

Assuming Vader was distracted by the duel, Fane Peturri attempted to take the opportunity to flee the moon. However, with Celeste subdued and held by clone troopers, Vader was able to block him, and correctly identified Peturri as an agent of Palpatine himself, sent to spy on Vader. Vader revealed that while [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] protected both himself and Celeste from the rakghoul plague, a mere environment suit could not protect Peturri from [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]]. Accordingly Peturri mutated into a rakghoul and Vader immediately slew it.<ref name="DT12" />

[[File:RAKinfection.jpg|thumb|right|The stormtroopers mutate into rakghouls.]]
With Vader distracted by the rakghoul Peturri, Celeste [[Telekinesis/Legends|threw away]] the clones guarding her and recovered her lightsaber, and re-engaged Darth Vader. During the chaos [[Schurk-Heren]] was able to subdue a clone trooper and steal a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], which he used to free the rest of the ''Uhumele's '' crew. They immediately ran for their ship, intending to escape.<ref name="DT12" />

Aware of the inevitability of her defeat, Celeste chose to utilize the full power of the Muur Talisman to prevent Vader from claiming it, immediately turning all clone troopers present into rakghouls – and, unfortunately, [[Crys Taanzer]]. Schurk-Heren was forced to shoot the newly infected Crys, at which point the remaining crew of the ''Uhumele'' made their escape.<ref name="DT12" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|What have you done, woman? That power is mine!|Karness Muur|<ref name="DT12" />}}
Suddenly outnumbered, Darth Vader was forced to flee the battle and retreated to his shuttle, having realized both that Celeste could not serve as his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] and that the Talisman would not serve his purpose. Celeste, without any means of leaving the world, then settled in to wait with her rakghoul servants until some other would arrive, content in the knowledge that Karness Muur was left just as trapped as she.<ref name="DT12" />
